cards.kicker: Just been asked to plan a hens
cards.h1: How far out do you actually book?
cards.sub: The honest Australian timeline, in weeks.

cards.text: Lock the city and the weekend. Nothing else can be booked until those two exist.

cards.title: Then, in this order
rows: 10 weeks: headcount, with a per-head number attached
8 weeks: accommodation, it sells out first
6 weeks: collect the money once, not three times

cards.text: Confirm final numbers with every venue. Most of them still cost you for anyone who pulls out after that.
One pinned message. Times, addresses, who is driving. That is the whole job.
Start at 12 weeks and you are choosing. Start at 6 and you are taking whatever is left.

cards.title: Plan it. Split it. Done.
cards.sub: Hens and bucks, sorted in Australia.
